title: An Observation on Generalization
channel: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing
summary: Ilya Sutskever gives a Simons Institute talk on why neural networks generalize, framing learning as finding short descriptions, like compression. It was part of the Large Language Models and Transformers program.
why: Cited in discussions of learning as compression and of why neural networks generalize.

quote.text: Ilya argues that the reason why neural networks generalize -- why they work at all -- is because they are effectively finding a simple description
